source.description: an address or a host name; a host name is resolved with DNS and its first IPv4 address is checked; left out, the path starts on device without a source

destination.description: an address or a host name; a host name is resolved with DNS and its first IPv4 address is traced

protocol.description: tcp, udp, icmp or sctp; tcp when left out

port.description: the destination port, a number; it decides NAT and PBF rules that name a service

device.description: the firewall the path starts on

router.description: the start's logical router; needs device

at.description: read each device's newest snapshot at or before this time; left out, the latest

detail.description: summary or full: how much of each result to return; summary when left out
